scope: Navigation disclosure lifecycle only; complete invented local fixture; no native/account/consumer/provider activity.

browser.scope: Invented local six-entry fixture, no login, native diagnostic disabled, external requests blocked
browser.keyboard_open: Control+B from Fixture action focuses Search pages inside the named Page navigation region; handle exposes expanded state
browser.keyboard_close: Escape restores Fixture action focus and removes the navigation region and all of its controls from the accessibility tree
browser.closed_tab: Tab from Fixture action reaches Open navigation; offscreen search does not intercept focus
browser.mobile_close: Escape after a literal-title search restores the Open navigation handle and removes the region from the accessibility tree
browser.remaining_scope: This accepts disclosure/focus lifecycle only; category, favorite/tag keyboard controls and full site accessibility remain separate work

incoming_control_review.review: Only unrelated browser QA source, its report path and claim arrived; no shared/page/engine/config/test code changed. Source compiled and static preflight passed. This lane did not execute the probe or read its report contents.
